final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS c FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.ordersmark AS o, s1.c AS c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / NULLIF(s2.total, 0) AS r FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM s3) SELECT s3.o, s3.c, s3.r, s3.r - s4.a AS d FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 10
